$Comment: Ice King bolt launch for rapid volleys (2026-10-21: in the bursts and the ice rain not every bolt was heard). Vanilla SFX_Staff_Ice_Shoot is 2.5 s long with MaxInstance 5, so from the 6th quick bolt on new plays were dropped while the first ones still rang. This is the same shot cut to 0.6 s with a fade (Ice_King_Bolt_Shot.ogg, mono), with room for 12 at once. MaxInstance = how many can sound together; Volume in dB like the vanilla one.
